display_rules: Namespace PDB, chain label, author chain, sequence position and alignment column independently.
Never draw links across missing label_seq_id gaps or between structures using chain names alone.
Null is unknown/excluded, not noncontact; false means no observed atom contact under the stated endpoint.
Full modeled footprint and strict analysis eligibility are different fields.
Contacts describe the deposited antibody complex, not general antigenicity, functional necessity or protective immunity.
The predeclared discordance-added model does not improve the primary blocked diagnostic; preserve the negative result.
8C1 literature rows are regional annotation, never direct-contact labels.
integration_scope: Optional scientific adapter only. Laptop owns the existing README/demo/submission; stable v0.2.1 remains independently usable.
